title: Mark subscribers who have not renewed as expired
summary: Every day, list the active subscribers whose renewal date passed by your grace days, ask you to approve, then mark them expired in your table and tell them how to renew.
description: Once a day, finds the active subscribers whose 'Renews on' date is past by more than the grace days you choose. If there are any, you get one request listing them, and nothing happens until you approve it. When you approve, each one is marked suspended in your subscribers table (so reminders and invoices stop for them) and sent a text saying their plan has ended and how to renew. Nothing is called outside Taskiem, so it suits a gym, a club, a class or any business that does not switch a service off in another system. If you do switch a service off elsewhere, use "Switch off subscribers who have not renewed, on your system". When they pay, "Renew a subscriber when they pay" brings them back.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: How your customers know you; it starts every message.

params.name: grace_days
params.title: Grace days
params.description: How many days after the renewal date a subscriber keeps their plan before you are asked to mark it expired.

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves switching people off, such as manager.

params.name: payment_details
params.title: How to pay
params.description: Added to the text each person gets, for example your account number and bank.
params.example: Pay to 0123456789, GTBank, and your membership starts again.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When it looks for expired subscribers, Lagos time.

params.name: subscribers_table
params.title: Subscribers table
params.description: Your subscribers: name, phone, plan, price each month, when it renews and whether they are active. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

definition.name: Mark subscribers who have not renewed as expired
definition.description: After your approval, marks the subscribers whose plan expired and tells them.

steps.name: Use your business name and payment details
Find who is past the grace days

output.people: =(has(steps.read_subscribers.output.rows) ? steps.read_subscribers.output.rows : []).filter(r, has(r.renews_on) && r.renews_on != null && timestamp(string(r.renews_on).substring(0, 10) + 'T00:00:00Z') + duration(string({{grace_days}} * 24) + 'h') < timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at))

steps.name: Ask you to approve marking them expired
Mark them suspended in your table
Text them their plan has ended, and how to renew

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': Hello ' + string(item.name) + ', your plan has ended because it was not renewed. ' + steps.settings.output.payment_details

steps.name: Tell you if there are more subscribers than one run covers

input.title: More subscribers than one run covers
input.message: This run covered the first 1,000 subscribers in your table. The rest were left out: they were not looked at, so nobody past their date among the rest is asked about.
